questions.fact: Bee glue! Propolis is a sticky, gooey stuff bees use around the hive.

questions.q: Where do bees get the sticky stuff to make propolis?
questions.fact: From trees! Bees collect sticky resin from tree buds and bark and mix it with beeswax.

questions.q: What do bees use propolis for in the hive?
questions.fact: Sealing cracks! Bee glue plugs little gaps to keep out drafts, rain, and pests.

questions.q: If a mouse sneaks into the hive and dies, what might the bees do?
questions.fact: Wrap it in propolis! It's too big to carry out, so bees seal it up to keep the hive clean and healthy.
